propositions: Current clarity_score awards points for volume and legacy shape (H2 headings, character counts, bullets) rather than enforcing the author-guide contract for required sections and grounded content.
The clarity measure is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py without synchronization, inviting drift when either is extended.

Deterministic checks can detect placeholder language (TBD, figure out, verify whether), AC checkbox proof clauses (operator-attested, verified by, check by), required section presence keyed on graph altitude (Context/Problem + AC for all; Approach + Scope for leaves; child decomposition for containers), and AC text hygiene (bundled outcomes, subjective terms, unproved hedges).
AC checkbox verification coverage should report proved_items / total_items; incomplete coverage is advisory until corpus evaluation demonstrates precision.

Author-guide and authoritative criteria conflict on Success Criteria (guide requests it; tests/G6 do not) and rejected alternatives (guide requires; G6 forbids); these conflicts must be resolved before encoding new clarity checks.

Testing shape (happy-path and failure/edge markers) and grounded Scope + structured file_impact are mechanically testable but should not replace LLM review of problem quality, mechanism correctness, positive rationale, and alternatives coherence.
